words.word: i unto her that was old

occurrences.text: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;
And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.
Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she with them?
